hook_anchors.excerpt: A loud wooden slam as the heavy double barn doors violently fly open.
hook_anchors.why: A violent, sudden intrusion interrupts the scene.

hook_anchors.excerpt: Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!
hook_anchors.why: Immediate, high-stakes life-or-death crisis declared right away.

hook_anchors.excerpt: He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!
hook_anchors.why: An accusation of cruelty by the authorities against a child.

hook_anchors.excerpt: The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!
hook_anchors.why: Outrageous arrogance that immediately enrages the viewer.
